import ConditionalGoldbach

#check @ConditionalGoldbach.theorem_1_1
#check @ConditionalGoldbach.theorem_1_2
#check @ConditionalGoldbach.primePair_consequence
#check @ConditionalGoldbach.proposition_B_5

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let names := env.header.moduleNames.map Name.toString
  liftIO <| IO.FS.writeFile "<temporary modules.json>" (toJson names).pretty
entries.diagnostics:
ConditionalGoldbach.theorem_1_1 : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ),
  ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
    ∃ C,
      0 < C ∧
        ∀ (h : ℕ → ℝ),
          ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually ConditionalGoldbach.GRH →
            ConditionalGoldbach.HypothesisS h →
              (ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually fun N =>
                  |ConditionalGoldbach.goldbach N φ -
                        ConditionalGoldbach.weightMass φ * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N| ≤
                    C * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N / h N) ∧
                ConditionalGoldbach.EvenAsymptotic (fun N => ConditionalGoldbach.goldbach N φ) fun N =>
                  ConditionalGoldbach.weightMass φ * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N
ConditionalGoldbach.theorem_1_2 : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ),
  ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
    ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually ConditionalGoldbach.GRH →
      ConditionalGoldbach.HypothesisR →
        ∃ C,
          0 < C ∧
            ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually fun N =>
              |ConditionalGoldbach.goldbach N φ -
                    ConditionalGoldbach.weightMass φ * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N| ≤
                C * ConditionalGoldbach.spectralScale N
ConditionalGoldbach.primePair_consequence : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ),
  ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
    ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually ConditionalGoldbach.GRH →
      (ConditionalGoldbach.HypothesisR ∨ ∃ h, ConditionalGoldbach.HypothesisS h) →
        ∃ C,
          0 < C ∧
            ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually fun N =>
              C * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N * ↑N / Real.log ↑N ^ 2 ≤ ↑(ConditionalGoldbach.PrimePairCount N)
ConditionalGoldbach.proposition_B_5 : ConditionalGoldbach.GRH ConditionalGoldbach.experimentN →
  ConditionalGoldbach.IsFiniteSpectrum ConditionalGoldbach.finiteEigenvalues ∧
    (∀ (q : ℂ),
        ConditionalGoldbach.finiteSpectralFunction q =
          ∏ j,
            (1 -
              ↑(4 * ConditionalGoldbach.finiteEigenvalues j ^ 2 /
                      ConditionalGoldbach.spectralScale ConditionalGoldbach.experimentN ^ 2) *
                  q *
                (1 - q))) ∧
      (∀ (q : ℂ), ConditionalGoldbach.finiteSpectralFunction (1 - q) = ConditionalGoldbach.finiteSpectralFunction q) ∧
        (ConditionalGoldbach.finiteMatrixOpNorm ≤ ConditionalGoldbach.spectralScale ConditionalGoldbach.experimentN →
          ∀ (q : ℂ), ConditionalGoldbach.finiteSpectralFunction q = 0 → q.re = 1 / 2)

  ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
    ∃ C,
      0 < C ∧

          ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually ConditionalGoldbach.GRH →
            ConditionalGoldbach.HypothesisS h →

  ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
    ConditionalGoldbach.EvenEventually ConditionalGoldbach.GRH →

ConditionalGoldbach.theorem_7_1_uniform : ∀ (N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N],
  Even N →
    Real.exp 10 < ↑N →
      ConditionalGoldbach.GRH N →
        ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ),
          ConditionalGoldbach.IsWeight φ →
            ∀ (ha : ConditionalGoldbach.alpha N < ConditionalGoldbach.beta),
              |ConditionalGoldbach.weightMass φ * ConditionalGoldbach.singularSeries N -
                    ConditionalGoldbach.goldbach N φ| ≤
                Real.exp 2 * ConditionalGoldbach.weightEnergy φ * ‖ConditionalGoldbach.residualOperator ha N‖
